messages:
evan_marketing: Heads-up for the launch appendix: marketing needs a "mini-assertion pack" from runtime that legal can rely on. Deadline: tomorrow 11am PT. Requirements: 1) 20 sanitized payloads (short/med/long/edge) + manifest CSV, 2) exact one-line run commands for Hosted and Dedicated, 3) p50/p95/p99 cold vs warmed with bootstrapped CI, 4) q4 vs FP delta with model tag + commit hash + quant recipe, 5) a recommended one-line PR-safe copy for press (legal will confirm). @priya_runtime @sam_eng :pray:

priya_runtime: We can do this. Quick clarifying q's: which model tag should we pin in the provenance? Also do you want streaming metrics shown anywhere or keep everything non-stream token-timing only?

evan_marketing: Pin to redwood-v2-7b:2026-03-stable. For slides/legal use non-stream token timings only. Well mention that the UX demo streams but that's a separate note.

sam_eng: Plan: we'll produce miniassert/2267890123/{payloads.json,manifest.csv,run_hosted.sh,run_dedicated.sh,report.csv,README.md}. We'll run 4 independent trials (fresh process each time) to capture variance, compute bootstrap CI for p95/p99. Deterministic sampling: temp=0, batch=1.

priya_runtime: Example copyable hosted command we'll include in README (exact):

REDWOOD_API_KEY=... ./run_hosted.sh --model redwood-v2-7b:2026-03-stable --quant q4 --payloads payloads.json --seq 512 --batch 1 --warmup 200 --repeats 4 --out out/2267890123

priya_runtime: Dedicated example (exact):

./run_dedicated.sh --model redwood-v2-7b:2026-03-stable --quant fp,q4 --seq 512 --batch 1 --warmup 200 --repeats 4 --out out/2267890123/dedicated

oliver_metrics: I'll compute per-request latencies (anonymized) and produce a small CSV with columns: trial_id, request_idx, latency_ms, token_count. From that I'll bootstrap 95% CI for p95 and p99 and add a tiny summary table. Also will add a note about variance sources.

evan_marketing: Legal specifically asked for a PR-safe line we can paste if numbers support it. Example placeholder: "Quantized (q4) p95 latency increased N% vs FP; p95 throughput improved M% (measured on redwood-v2-7b:2026-03-stable, q4 recipe X)." Please fill with exact measured numbers and CI.

priya_runtime: We'll include the exact one-line sentence in README.md with measured values and the provenance string in the exact format legal requested: run_by:<name>; run_ts:<UTC ISO>; model_tag:<tag>; commit:<git-sha>; quant_recipe:<name>.

sam_eng: Small note: one long prompt contained copyrighted text; we sanitized and flagged it in manifest.csv with synthetic_flag=TRUE. If marketing wants to keep a "real-world-like" long case, we included a sanitized analogue.

priya_runtime: Uploading artifacts to staging bucket and will post the GS link here when done. We'll also attach raw profiler snippets (private) so eng/product can explain cold-start root causes; marketing won't publish those.

artifact-bot: artifact uploaded: gs://redwood-bench/miniassert/2267890123/miniassert-pack.tar.gz (payloads.json, manifest.csv, run_hosted.sh, run_dedicated.sh, report.csv, README.md, profiler/)

oliver_metrics: One more ask for legal: if they request a re-run, please include the artifact id and we will re-run with identical seed and capture system traces to reproduce. That helps make the claim defensible.

evan_marketing: Thanks everyone. We'll review README+report first thing and flag any wording changes for legal. If numbers look flaky we'll request the re-run and attach traces. Huge help! :rocket:
